name: a3-precision-drawing-studio
description: Precision 2D drawing and editing on an A3 sheet

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/build-electron.mjs
scripts.e2e: node tests-e2e/electron-smoke.mjs && node tests-e2e/milestone2.mjs && node tests-e2e/milestone3.mjs && node tests-e2e/milestone4.mjs && node tests-e2e/milestone5.mjs && node tests-e2e/milestone6.mjs
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --mac
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never --dir
